market_summary: All monitored assets (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAGUSD, BTCUSD) reflect a dominant macro-bearish intraday trend following earlier New York session drops, with prices suppressed well below their respective session VWAPs, EMA50 structural baselines, and Value Area Lows. However, price action across the board has settled into low-volatility midday consolidation with below-average participation (RVOL < 1.0 on all symbols and zero yellow volume spikes in the last 15-18 bars). EURUSD and GBPUSD are resting directly on or near Session Lows at the lower ATR envelopes without breakout confirmation; XAUUSD is pinned to its Gamma Flip (3873.51) in a Positive Dampening regime; XAGUSD and BTCUSD are drifting mid-channel. Disciplined quantitative rules mandate a selective HOLD stance across all symbols to prevent capital erosion during low-volume exhaustion chop.

Given dealer dampening and lack of volume at the Gamma Flip, entering directional positions presents poor expectancy.
